show.description: When TerraGem’s young VP Alisha Talwar goes undercover as an intern to expose a massive money-fraud, a ruthless social climber, Reva, steals her identity as “Mrs. Talwar” and turns the office into a bullying circus. To save her marriage, her company—and her own name—Alisha must outplay the impostor and catch the laundering ring before it destroys her.
